version: 0.4.3
kind: menu-item
schema_type: object

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.menu-item
  name: menu-item.schema
  description: Canonical menu item schema defining actionable UI commands, optional item headers, and item-local border styling.

spec:
  target_kind: menu-item
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true
  imports:
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-udi-fields
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-styling
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-control-structures

fields:
  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: label
    path: label
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: header
    path: header
    type: object
    required: false

  - name: capability
    path: capability
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: colour_role
    path: colour_role
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: semantic_role
    path: semantic_role
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: colour_scheme
    path: colour_scheme
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: border_pattern
    path: border_pattern
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: visibility_mode
    path: visibility_mode
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: enable_mode
    path: enable_mode
    type: string
    required: false

object:
  id: ""
  udi: ""
  label: ""
  header:
    id: ""
    text: ""
    colour_role: ""
    colour_scheme: ""
    border_pattern: ""
  capability: ""
  colour_role: ""
  colour_scheme: ""
  border_pattern: ""
  visibility_mode: static
  enable_mode: enabled
